title: Obben Rorr Electric Sportbike 100kmh (Classic Heritage)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Obben Electric Obben Rorr Electric Sportbike 100kmh (Classic Heritage) is engineered for relaxed boulevard cruising backed by muscular roll-on passing power. At its heart lies a 100cc powertrain delivering 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 108 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Aggressive Forward Tuck posture paired with a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
